groups.name: Choose what deserves AI assistance
groups.rationale: Start with purpose, stakes and an explicit human responsibility.

groups.name: Protect attention and know when to stop
groups.rationale: Adds offline thinking and opportunity-cost failure cases, not just faster output.

groups.name: Form your own answer first
groups.rationale: Combines a practitioner who reversed AI-first advice with an explicit human reasoning baseline.

groups.name: Get criticism while retaining authorship
groups.rationale: Named writers describe actual boundaries; comparisons with personal meaning expose limits of AI interpretation.

groups.name: Explain, practise and try without assistance
groups.rationale: The learner must answer or explain; model feedback is not itself a learning measure.

groups.name: Check claims against records
groups.rationale: Pairs traceable checking routines with documented prompt-only checking failures.

groups.name: Test outputs and changing frames
groups.rationale: Task-specific tests and expert error review are stronger than general trust in a model.

groups.name: Keep agent work inspectable and bounded
groups.rationale: Includes stopping, permission and review costs, alongside failures of opaque delegation.

groups.name: Remain involved in coding and prototyping
groups.rationale: Pairs active review with two-human collaboration and failure examples; working software is not proof of understanding.

groups.name: Supply context and preserve expert decisions
groups.rationale: Connects clarification, evidence gathering and accountable decisions in real work.

groups.name: Turn inquiry into a decision
groups.rationale: Questions serve a decision; predictions and later checks help distinguish confidence from accuracy.

groups.name: Generate possibilities and make your own creative choice
groups.rationale: Different media and perspectives offer possibilities; personal meaning and selection stay with the person.

groups.name: Preserve inquiry in family and education settings
groups.rationale: Adds child-led inquiry and participation in rules beyond professional knowledge work.

groups.name: Learn as a team without losing independent views
groups.rationale: Connects local experiments, independent contributions and return to actual user evidence.

groups.name: Look for missing and contrary evidence
groups.rationale: Adds disconfirmation, survey-question quality and direct contact with people affected.

groups.name: Make responsibility and provenance visible
groups.rationale: Covers disclosure, process records, system objectives and who can use collected information.

groups.name: Recognize false authority and misleading feedback
groups.rationale: These are counterexamples, not recommended prompts: personal guesses and flattering feedback are not evidence.

groups.name: Keep human advisers and practise human reasoning
groups.rationale: Explicit transfer sources: actual relationships, arguing a case yourself and low-stakes rehearsal.

groups.name: Protect the thinking involved in making an artifact
groups.rationale: Explicit transfer sources: writing, first-hand experience and evaluation before automating production.
